core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mahbub is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Beloved, cherished”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mahbub corresponds to the Arabic form محبوب (Arabic root ح ب ب (ḥ-b-b); مَحْبُوب (Maḥbūb)). Its core sense is beloved, cherished.
